card.name: Punctuation inside Revelation verse citations
card.fires_on: Punctuation and digits inside Bible citations to the book of Revelation, such as the opening parenthesis, the dash, the colon or the digits in 'Rev. 19:11-16'. It also fires weakly on a digit in a future year.

modes.label: Revelation reference marks
modes.description: The parenthesis, colon, dash or verse digit inside a citation of Revelation in a theological passage about Christ's return.

modes.label: Opening parenthesis before citation
modes.description: The open parenthesis just before a Revelation reference after a quoted phrase about Christ.

modes.label: Future year digit
modes.description: A digit within a year in the near future, in a news item about a space station.
modes.example: The station is expecting to be in orbit by 20<<2>>0.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about endlessness such as forever, eternity and permanently, and away from words like compact.
card.plain: It lights up on the numbers and punctuation of end-times Bible citations, and nudges the model toward words about eternity.
